title: The updated version is not available
author: JohnnyB-ro

status.label: Needs update-path diagnostics
status.detail: The author confirmed Store reinstall still installs 0.100.2, but logs are needed to separate update-check behavior from Store delivery or mixed registration.

next_action.label: Request update diagnostics
next_action.reason: Capture a fresh report after Check for updates and identify the Store/winget source.

judgment.rationale: The screenshot and reinstall resolve the original reproduction gap. The remaining decision is whether PowerToys failed to read the GitHub release, Store serves an older package, or multiple registrations confuse the version.
evidence: The author reproduced after completely removing and reinstalling from Microsoft Store.
The Store installation remains 0.100.2 while stable 0.101.2362.0 was published on 2026-08-25.
Other Store applications update normally on the same machine.
PowerToys update checking queries GitHub release endpoints and records update/network state.
judgment.recommended_action: Request a fresh /bugreport immediately after the failed check plus the Store Library version and winget source, then route to updater or release-distribution ownership.

issue_context.summary: A Microsoft Store installation remains on 0.100.2 and PowerToys reports no update even after a full Store reinstall, despite stable 0.101.2362.0 being available.
known_information: The author supplied a screenshot and concrete steps after the automated request.
A full uninstall and Store reinstall produced the same old version.
The issue now has Needs-Team-Response rather than Needs-Author-Feedback.
PowerToys manual update checks use GitHub stable-release metadata.
inferences: The repeated Store reinstall makes a transient UI mistake less likely, but does not identify Store delivery versus update-state parsing.
A mixed Store/GitHub/winget registration is possible but not established.
issue_context.analysis: The author has answered the reproduction request, so waiting_on_author is stale. A diagnostic captured after the button press and the installed package source are the smallest evidence set that changes ownership and implementation decisions.
initial_investigation: Verified stable v0.101.2362.0 and preview v0.101.2373.0 release publication.
Inspected src/runner/UpdateUtils.cpp and src/common/updating/updating.cpp GitHub update paths.
No linked fix, duplicate, assignee, or maintainer resolution is present.

information_gaps.information: A fresh diagnostic archive captured immediately after the failed Check for updates action.
information_gaps.why_needed: Updater logs distinguish network/release parsing, cached state, and up-to-date decisions.
information_gaps.how_to_collect: After reproducing, add a comment containing /bugreport and upload the generated ZIP.

information_gaps.information: The Store Library version and the package source reported by winget.
information_gaps.why_needed: This distinguishes stale Store delivery from mixed package registration.
information_gaps.how_to_collect: Share the PowerToys Store Library entry and source from winget list Microsoft.PowerToys.

actions.label: Request update-path diagnostics

comment.body: Thanks for confirming that a Store reinstall still installs 0.100.2 while other Store apps update, and for the screenshot. Please reproduce once more, then add a comment containing `/bugreport` immediately after pressing Check for updates in PowerToys Settings. Also include the Microsoft Store Library entry/version shown for PowerToys and whether `winget list Microsoft.PowerToys` reports Store (`msstore`) or another source. This will distinguish a GitHub update-check failure from stale Store package delivery or mixed registration.
